purpose: Read-only forensic accounting of the previously identified newly admitted original-C outer-fold-2 market paths; no fitting, policy selection, threshold tuning, or risk certification.

data_access.allowed: Frozen joint_liquidity_refit_v1 saved CSV, NPZ traces and metadata; joint_liquidity_summary_v1 receipts for corroboration only

population.incremental_cohort: All 24 original scenario IDs with automated primary and non-automated canonical status, expected outer_fold_2 only
population.common_context: All 48 original IDs automated by both learners, descriptive saved-arm metrics only, kept separate
population.neither_context: All 48 original IDs not automated by either learner; admission inventory only, no invented learner financial outcomes
population.units: Market paths for one client under five overlapping refits, not customers or independent deployment trials

path: first recovery to original crossing peak
distribution: fractionally weighted upper-tail 10% empirical CVaR MDD
fixed_metrics.pairs: All 24 same-original-ID primary-minus-reference differences for both references; breach contingency counts and annual exposure/action divergence summaries
fixed_metrics.independent_consistency: Reconstruct annual-checkpoint MDD by all peak-trough intervals, growth by terminal/initial wealth, cost/moved identity, holdings/weights/accounting, crossing and absorbing flags, pending behavior, fees/trades and exported CSV metrics; no raw returns needed

event_witness_selection.rule: Union of all incremental-cohort scenario IDs breached under any of the three saved arms, plus the minimum original scenario ID with no breach under any arm
event_witness_selection.all_years: Export all 30 annual decisions for every arm of each selected witness; never select best/worst return after seeing outcomes
event_witness_selection.ordering: Original scenario IDs ascending, year ascending, fixed policy order

interpretation_limits: Same-ID saved policy differences are descriptive computational comparisons; exposure or action divergence alone does not causally attribute additional breaches.
Targets and dynamic rules may differ from the exact-thirds reference; cost and exposure effects are not isolated.
Fractional empirical CVaR and P90 describe 24 reused paths and are not confidence bounds or population tail-risk estimates.
Annual-checkpoint drawdown follows the contest implementation; no claim about unobserved intra-year drawdown or realizable cash-withdrawal protection.
No confidence interval or binomial certificate is computed for adaptively reused development paths.
No empirical winner is selected and no paper is written.
